disagreements.text: Whether GTA VI lets you replay story missions from a list is not confirmed yet. If it does, the six missables above are only mildly missable — a replay fixes them. If it does not, they are the trophies to do during the story. This guide flags them either way and says so.
disagreements.title: Are missions replayable?

disagreements.text: No published list of missables exists for a game a day old. Our six flags are our judgment from the official descriptions: partner-gated trophies and one-shot story moments. Another guide may flag more or fewer. We would rather flag six with reasons than claim a certainty we do not have.
disagreements.title: The exact missable set

disagreements.text: Counts in this guide come from two places: the official descriptions (250 stunts, 42 range challenges, 14 drone locations, 20 races, 18 meditation spots, 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK spots, 50 challenges, 100 vehicles, 52 areas, 9 gangs, 8 garages, 10 Scooter Bros vehicles, 5 vaults) and PSNProfiles' tracked targets (9 activity types, 8 stranger strands, 500 choices, $250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent). Where the two disagree, PSN's live count wins — check it in-game.
disagreements.title: PSN progress counts

disagreements.text: PlayStation hides 28 of the 55 until earned. This guide does not claim to know exactly which 28: the spoiler setting hides story trophies instead, which is what the setting is for — names and descriptions of story trophies stay hidden until you earn them.
disagreements.title: The 28 hidden trophies

disagreements.text: Every guide here is our own words, built from the official description of its trophy. Where a guide says how to do something the description does not spell out, it is our advice — not a fact checked in the game. The game is a day old and nobody outside Rockstar has played it through. We say so on every guide that needs it rather than inventing a walkthrough.
disagreements.title: What 'our advice' means

missables.why: Needs a partner beside you at 4 stars. Partners are story-limited.
Needs a partner for three shops in a row. Partners are story-limited.
An unscheduled departure at VCIA — most likely tied to the VCIA Takedown mission.
A showroom smash that reads like a story beat, not a free-roam stunt.
Rhino tanks most likely appear in one story sequence.
Second time's the charm — if the trigger is a one-shot moment, a first-try success may close it.

stages.blurb: Play the story to its end. All 18 story trophies live here: the opening, four chapters, the final mission, six mission trophies, and five stranger finals. Do the story-moment missables (Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Catch Me If You Can, Capital Offense, Challenging Tank, Bad Luck I Guess) while the story is live — partners and set-pieces do not wait for free roam.
stages.tip: If a mission can be replayed from the mission list, a missed moment costs only a replay. Whether missions are replayable is not confirmed in-game yet — see Sources.
stages.title: Story first

stages.blurb: Cover the map. 52 areas, 100 vehicles, 100 WAiNK spots, 18 meditation spots, 3 card sets, a unique animal, 8 garages, 10 Scooter Bros registrations. One long sweep of the state covers most of them at once — drive everything you see and stop at every spot.
stages.tip: Pair this stage with the 100% completion gold: the map is the biggest single chunk of it.
stages.title: See all of Leonida

stages.blurb: Work the side pastimes: 250 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, 20 races, 14 drone-race locations, fishing against Cal, one arcade game, 50 challenges, bowling at Kolt & Associates, and 8 stranger strands. One try of each of the 9 activity types also closes Master of None.
stages.tip: Ranges and races can be retried forever — save the skill trophies for after the story, when you have the full weapon and vehicle set.
stages.title: Activities & skill

stages.blurb: Robberies and cash: 5 bank vaults, an armored truck, a jewelry store undetected, one operation per gang, $250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent, 5 enemies in one Combat Focus, and the odd moments — a cocktail on Ocean Beach, a showroom smash, a strange sighting, 500 choices.
stages.tip: Robberies fund the money trophies: vaults and trucks pay for the garages and the shopping spree.
stages.title: Money & mayhem

stages.blurb: Two trophies left: the 100% completion gold, then the platinum. Check the in-game completion stat — by now the only gaps are the stragglers from the earlier stages. Close them, watch the gold pop, and the platinum follows on its own.
stages.tip: If the completion stat stalls, the gap is usually a stranger strand or a collectible set — the checklist's filters find it.
stages.title: The last mile
